commands.command: /opt/homebrew/bin/zsh -lc "rg -o 'IP-KIT-[A-Z0-9-]+|TEMP-LOG-[A-Z0-9-]+|DEPOT-LANE-[A-Z0-9-]+|Window [0-9:–-]+ UTC' index.html | sort | uniq -c && rg -o 'data-bench=\"kit-view-option\"|data-bench=\"product-kit-case\"|data-bench=\"temperature-log-id\"|data-bench=\"depot-lane-id\"|data-bench=\"transfer-window\"|data-bench=\"pharmacist-note-toggle\"|data-bench=\"release-review-form\"' index.html | sort | uniq -c && rg -n 'word-break|font-size:37|min-width:1120|min-width:980|min-width:960' index.html || true"

/opt/homebrew/bin/zsh -lc "git diff -- index.html; echo '--- counts ---'; rg -o 'data-bench=\"product-kit-case\"' index.html | wc -l; rg -o 'data-bench=\"temperature-log-id\"' index.html | wc -l; rg -o 'data-bench=\"depot-lane-id\"' index.html | wc -l; rg -o 'data-bench=\"transfer-window\"' index.html | wc -l; rg -o 'data-bench=\"kit-view-option\"' index.html | wc -l; rg -n 'min-width|word-break|overflow-x|font: 50|font-size: 37|muted|decision|register|lanes' index.html | sed -n '1,160p'"

/opt/homebrew/bin/zsh -lc 'command -v chromium || command -v chromium-browser || command -v google-chrome || command -v playwright || command -v wkhtmltoimage || true; command -v html5validator || true; command -v node || true; command -v npm || true'
